notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner's own ability by paying {1} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Farmstead Gleaner.
Repeat.
